instruction: Could you please change Chrome's memory usage limit to only use 500 MB of RAM maximum? I have limited memory on my computer and need Chrome to stay within this constraint even when I have multiple tabs open.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome does not provide user-configurable settings to limit maximum memory usage. Chrome's memory management is handled automatically by the browser's internal processes and the operating system. Users cannot set hard caps on RAM usage through Chrome's settings interface.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly classified as infeasible - Chrome does not provide user-facing settings to limit maximum RAM usage
